item.description:
Formula 0.1.85

  • Ideas: closing the laptop lid no longer stops an agent as "did nothing" (#160)
  • Shipping: a gh or git command stuck on the network no longer stops Formula checking pull requests (#159)
  • Shipping: a pull request that needs review no longer looks ready when GitHub fails to send the branch's rules (#158)
  • Ideas: one idea that can't be read no longer wipes every idea, and the original file is kept (#157)
